title: Fix the four known file divergences in the parity lane
description: tools/parity/known_divergences.txt still lists four file-level differences between kbs and kanbus: dependencies::file::project/issues/kbs-aa0002.json, init::file::.kanbus.yml, init::file::CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md and update_comment_close::file::project/issues/kbs-aa0001.json. Make both runtimes write byte-identical files for these cases and empty the list; the lane then guards file fidelity (the golden cross-runtime test kbs-232185 asked for).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #542 merged with CI green (parity-exempt: Python brought in line with Rust). Python init now writes the full default .kanbus.yml in Rust order, carries the full CONTRIBUTING_AGENT template text, and sorts issue custom keys. tools/parity/known_divergences.txt is empty and the lane passes.
